source.section: PDF p.45 Form 39R instructions Line 8, 8a-8c and Line 8e first paragraph; PDF p.33 Form 39R Part B lines 8a-8f; PDF p.10 Line 12a; PDF p.11 worksheet line 5 ('born before January 2, 1961'); Form 40 lines 7-11, 12a, 15-20, 26 (PDF p.29-30); instructions PDF p.10-11 Standard Deduction Worksheet lines 1-6 and Line 20 worksheet lines 1-5; PDF p.13-14 Line 43 and Food Tax Credit Worksheet; PDF p.12 Line 31; record brackets and base.deductions cites

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution (person 1) 40,000.00 + military retirement pay (person 0) 30,000.00 = 70,000.00. Federal taxable income = 70,000.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 1,600.00 age 65 additional = 36,900.00 (the federal senior deduction is ignored). Form 40 (filing status married filing jointly): line 7 federal AGI 70,000.00. Line 8 additions 0.00; line 9 = 70,000.00 + 0.00 = 70,000.00. Form 39R Part B line 7 Social Security and railroad benefits included in federal income = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Line 8 retirement benefits deduction: line 8a 72,324.00; line 8b railroad benefits received 0.00; line 8c Social Security received (gross, both spouses, Box 5) 0.00; line 8d = 72,324.00 - 0.00 - 0.00, not below zero, = 72,324.00; line 8e (person 0 age 61: 30,000.00 does not qualify, under 62) = 0.00; line 8f smaller of 8d and 8e = 0.00. Line 18 health insurance premiums: none in the inputs, 0.00. Line 24 total subtractions = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Form 40 line 10 0.00; line 11 total adjusted income = 70,000.00 - 0.00 = 70,000.00. Line 12a boxes checked 1. Standard Deduction Worksheet: line 1 31,500.00; line 4 31,500.00; line 5 1 x 1,600.00 = 1,600.00; line 6 33,100.00. Line 15 0.00 (no Schedule A); line 16 33,100.00. Line 17 = 70,000.00 - 33,100.00 = 36,900.00. Line 18 federal Form 1040 lines 13a and 13b taken as 0.00; line 19 Idaho taxable income 36,900.00. Line 20 worksheet: line 1 36,900.00; line 2 9,622.00; line 3 = 27,278.00; line 4 at 5.3%; line 5 tax = 27,278.00 x 5.3% = 1445.734, to the cent 1,445.73 (the return rounds to whole dollars, PDF p.8, and shows 1,446; expected keeps the formula). Lines 21-24 credits 0.00; line 25 0.00; line 26 1,445.73. Food Tax Credit Worksheet (Form 40 line 43): 2 x 155.00 = 310.00. State income tax = 1,445.73 - 310.00 = 1,135.73. Line 31 Permanent Building Fund tax 10.00 is on the return but the projection does not charge it (approximations). Line 18 would take any federal Schedule 1-A amount, the senior deduction included; it is ignored here and the projection does not subtract it (approximations). The pensioner's own age counts, not the older spouse's: person 0 is under 62, not employed, and not classified as disabled, so the return gives no deduction either.
accepted_approximations: The Permanent Building Fund tax of 10 a return (Form 40 line 31) is not charged.
The federal Schedule 1-A and qualified business income deductions are not subtracted (Form 40 line 18).
